name: Handwoven Jute Table Runner
description: A rustic jute table runner with a hand-stitched indigo trim, handwoven by artisans in West Bengal. Adds texture to a dining table without overpowering the setting.

name: Ceramic Pour-Over Coffee Dripper
description: A single-cup stoneware pour-over dripper with a ribbed interior for even extraction. Pairs with any standard mug.

name: Brass Diya Set (Set of 4)
description: Four hand-cast brass diyas with a hammered finish, small enough for a windowsill or festive tablescape.

name: Copper Water Bottle
description: A pure hammered-copper water bottle with a leak-proof screw cap, following traditional Ayurvedic copper-storage practice.

name: Bamboo Cutting Board with Handle
description: A sturdy bamboo cutting board with a cut-out handle for easy hanging storage. Naturally antimicrobial.

name: Linen Blend Cushion Covers (Set of 2)
description: Soft linen-cotton cushion covers with a concealed zip closure. An easy, low-commitment way to refresh a sofa.

name: Terracotta Planter with Saucer
description: A classic unglazed terracotta planter with matching saucer, sized for a succulent or small indoor plant.

name: Stoneware Dinner Plate Set (Set of 4)
description: Matte-glazed stoneware dinner plates with a slightly irregular, handmade rim. Microwave and dishwasher safe.

name: Cast Iron Tawa (Griddle)
description: A pre-seasoned cast iron tawa built for everyday roti and dosa making, develops a natural non-stick surface with use.

name: Woven Cane Storage Basket
description: A hand-woven cane basket with sturdy handles, useful for laundry, throws, or general clutter corralling.

name: Scented Soy Candle Trio
description: Three hand-poured soy wax candles in sandalwood, lavender, and citrus, packaged together in a gift-ready box.

name: Marble & Brass Coasters (Set of 4)
description: Polished white marble coasters trimmed in brass, a small but noticeably premium-feeling housewarming pick.

name: Handloom Cotton Table Napkins (Set of 6)
description: Handloom-woven cotton napkins in a simple check weave, generously sized for everyday dining.

name: Wooden Spice Box (Masala Dabba)
description: A round sheesham-wood spice box with a fitted lid and 7 small steel containers inside, a modern take on the classic masala dabba.

name: Stainless Steel Insulated Casserole
description: A double-walled insulated casserole that keeps rotis and rice warm for hours, with a copper-tone lid.

name: Glass Jar Storage Set (Set of 3)
description: Borosilicate glass jars with airtight bamboo lids, useful for pantry staples or a tidier countertop.

name: Handpainted Ceramic Wall Plates (Set of 2)
description: Decorative ceramic plates with hand-painted floral motifs, meant for wall display rather than dining, sold with hanging hooks.

name: Wool Blend Table Mat Set (Set of 4)
description: Woven wool-cotton placemats with a subtle herringbone texture, sturdier than cotton alone for daily use.

name: Rattan Pendant Lampshade
description: A hand-woven rattan pendant shade that casts warm dappled light, fits standard E27 fittings (bulb not included).

name: Enamel Storage Canisters (Set of 3)
description: Enamel-coated steel canisters in graduated sizes with hinged lids, sturdy enough for daily flour/sugar/tea use.

name: Handcrafted Wooden Coaster Set with Stand
description: Mango-wood coasters with a matching upright stand for easy storage between uses.

name: Cotton Kitchen Apron with Pocket
description: A durable cotton canvas apron with an adjustable neck strap and a single front pocket.

name: Stainless Steel French Press
description: A double-wall stainless steel French press that keeps coffee hotter for longer than glass versions, with a fine steel mesh filter.

name: Macrame Wall Hanging
description: A hand-knotted cotton macrame wall hanging with a wooden dowel, adds texture to a bare wall without needing a frame.
